sources.name: Practical Cheminformatics Blogger archive
sources.content_policy: Local retrieval cache only; attribute each post and do not reproduce long passages.

sources.name: Practical Cheminformatics current GitHub Pages site
sources.authentication: none for normal public rate limits; optional GITHUB_TOKEN
sources.license: Repository declares MIT; preserve attribution and linked-source rights.

coverage_rule: A successful refresh must retrieve every record reported by the Blogger feed and every _posts Markdown blob reported by the GitHub tree API.
guest_rule: Guest posts are included as blog context but explicitly marked and never represented as Pat Walters's own writing.

publication_metadata.name: Google Scholar profile
publication_metadata.note: Discovery pointer only; automated scraping is not required.

publication_metadata.name: PubMed
publication_metadata.note: Use bibliographic metadata and abstracts subject to NCBI policies; do not ingest publisher-controlled full text without permission.
